title: Chapter 698 - 698 Ten Months Pregnancy; River Of Time (2)
content:
Chapter 698 - 698 Ten Months Pregnancy; River Of Time (2)

Chapter 698 - 698 Ten Months Pregnancy; River of Time (2)

698 Ten Months Pregnancy; River of Time (2)

She looked like a piece of art, so beautiful that people could not take their eyes off her.

When Hu Tian’s beautiful eyes met Lin Fan’s, her pretty face flushed red.

Then, she slowly opened her cherry-like mouth and exhaled a mouthful of sweet hot air. “Lin Fan, let’s have a child.”

Lin Fan was stunned.

In his mind, the image of a baby being born, growing up, and calling him father suddenly appeared.

For a moment, he felt an inexplicable sense of anticipation.

Thus, he nodded lightly and said, “Alright.”

When Hu Tian heard this, her pretty face turned even redder.

She leaned toward Lin Fan.

A bolt of lightning streaked across the sky, illuminating the two of them.

…

After an unknown period of time, Hu Tian slowly walked out.

A moment later, Han Tian walked in.

She whispered, “I… I also want a child.”

…

Such days lasted for a year.

On this day, Lin Fan suddenly felt life fluctuations in Hu Tian’s and Chu Yunyue’s stomachs.

His heart raced.

At the same time, he suddenly had some enlightenment.

The combination of yin and yang, the creation of life and death!

Instantly, a black energy and a white energy emanated from Lin Fan’s body.

With Lin Fan as the center, these two energies revolved around him like two small fish swimming around. Gradually, they formed an Eight Trigrams Formation.

The Eight Trigrams Formation continued to expand. After a while, the entire sky turned black and white.

It was extremely strange!

Everyone looked up, took out their phones to take photos, or discussed.

At this moment, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve comprehended Yin Laws (Elementary).]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve comprehended Yang Laws (Elementary).]

[Ding! Congratulations. You’ve obtained ten types of nomological Great Dao, 1,000,000,000 EXP, Basic Nomological Upgrade Gem x1, Heaven and Earth Enlightenment x1, River of Time Entrance x1.]

Lin Fan could feel the two mysterious powers within his body, as well as the energy that was constantly increasing. A faint smile appeared on his face.

He restrained his aura, and the black and white colors on his body and the black screen disappeared without a trace.

Everything returned to normal.

At this moment, Hu Tian and Qiu Ziqian jogged over.

They said excitedly, “Lin Fan, we seem to have conceived!”

It was difficult for ordinary people to notice even if they were pregnant.

However, after more than ten years of cultivation, the two women were no longer ordinary people. They could easily feel the changes in their bodies.

“Yes, we’re going to be parents soon!” Lin Fan said.

At this point, a smile appeared on his face.

Han Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling, Xia Xue, Xia Bing, and the others followed. They were happy about this, but at the same time, they were a little disappointed.

Why had they not conceived?

On this day, the entire Coiling Dragon Villa was filled with laughter.

In the following period of time, Lin Fan was just like many other fathers who were about to become fathers. He took care of Hu Tian and Qiu Ziqian very carefully.

In the blink of an eye, nine months had passed.

As the old saying went, pregnancy took ten months.

However, this was not a complete sentence.

To put it simply, a woman would be pregnant for at most ten months.

This was because most people would give birth after nine months of pregnancy. At most, they would give birth after ten months of pregnancy.

However, nine months had passed, and Hu Tian’s and Qiu Ziqian’s stomachs did not show any signs of getting bigger, let alone giving birth.

This made everyone feel very surprised.

If it were not for the fact that there were still two lives beating in their stomachs, everyone would probably think that they were not pregnant at all.

“Good things take time!” Dai Weixue comforted. “Perhaps the children want to stay with their mothers’ wombs for a while longer, so they’re not in a hurry.”

Everyone could only nod in agreement.

Gradually, 24 months passed.

Hu Tian’s and Qiu Ziqian’s stomachs did not change much.

At first, Hu Tian and Qiu Ziqian were not in a hurry. They only focused on their pregnancy.

However, as time passed, they became a little anxious.

They began to eat spiritual fruits and cultivate diligently.

This was because they were worried that the children in their stomachs might not have enough nutrition.

Perhaps that was why they could not grow up.

Or perhaps their children was like what was described in those novels. They had inherited the powerful bloodline of their parents and needed to grow in their mothers’ stomachs for thousands of years before they could be born.

If it was the second case, they would at least be able to live for a few more thousand years, right?

Otherwise, they would die of old age before the children were born. What should they do then?

Originally, Han Tian, Su Ningjing, Huang Ling, Song Jiaxin, and the others also wanted to work harder and get pregnant as soon as possible.

However, with Hu Tian and Qiu Ziqian as examples, they began to take a break and cultivate even harder.

Only with a higher cultivation and a longer lifespan could they successfully give birth to children.

All of a sudden, the entire cultivation atmosphere in the Coiling Dragon Villa was unprecedentedly intense.

Lin Fan looked at the group of people who were training hard and had a weird look on his face.

Then, he slowly focused his attention on the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem and the Life Law (Elementary).

[Do you want to use the Beginner Rule Upgrade Gem on the Life Law (Elementary)?]

“Yes!”

Instantly, Lin Fan’s entire body was filled with a life force that was as vigorous as the ocean.

Even though the courtyard he was in was filled with stone slabs, in the blink of an eye, an emerald green plant grew on the rock at a speed visible to the naked eye. A gorgeous flower bloomed.

The fragrance was overflowing, and it was beautiful!

This scene quickly attracted the attention of everyone who was cultivating hard.

“It smells so good!” they exclaimed.

“So beautiful!”

“It’s so beautiful!”

…

“Lin Fan, did you break through again?” Hu Tian asked.

Lin Fan said, “There’s a breakthrough in the power of laws.”

When everyone heard that, they were even happier. Their eyes that were looking at Lin Fan became even more heated.

This was the man they liked!

It was nighttime, and the wind howled again. Rain fell on the window, making a sound.

In the blink of an eye, a month had passed.

On this day, Lin Fan sat alone in his bedroom and placed his attention on the River of Time.

[Ding! Enter the River of Time?]

A white hole appeared in Lin Fan’s mind.

He had a very feeling that as long as he willed it, he could reach the unknown world.

Lin Fan muttered, “What’s the River of Time?”

[The River of Time is an extremely mysterious river. Walking in it can increase one’s comprehension of various laws, cultivation techniques, array formations, and speed up cultivation.]

Lin Fan was stunned.

The system… actually knew how to answer questions?

“Is it dangerous to enter the River of Time?” Lin Fan asked hurriedly.

[There’s a certain degree of danger.]

“Will I die?”

[No.]

“Then what kind of danger will I face?”

[You need to spend 100 spirit stones for the answer.]

Lin Fan did not even think. “I want the answer!”

Now, he was on Earth.

Spirit crystals might be very difficult to obtain.

However, it was not difficult to obtain spirit stones…

This was because there were many spirit stone mines on Earth.

Instantly, the 100 spirit stones in Lin Fan’s internal space turned into a beam of light and disappeared.

[If you encounter an expert who’s also walking in the River of Time, there’s a possibility of being attacked. The River of Time allows one’s soul to enter it. Normally, one’s soul will be damaged if one is defeated. However, after entering the River of Time, the system has a special power to protect the host’s soul. Therefore, the soul will not be affected.]

When Lin Fan heard this, he finally calmed down.

Then, his gaze landed on the entrance of the River of Time again.

With a slight thought…

In the next moment, he felt as if his entire body was being pulled in by a powerful suction force.
